descriptionChirho: A thrusting weapon with a long shaft and pointed head; used as a standard military weapon alongside the sword (cherev). Cognate with Aramaic rumchaa, Arabic rumh, Ethiopic remh. Appears frequently in military contexts: Num 25:7 (Phinehas takes a spear), Judg 5:8 (no spear seen among forty thousand), 1 Sam 18:28 (with spears), Neh 4:13-21 (half held spears while others built), 2 Chr 11:12, 14:8, 25:5, 26:14 (army equipped with spears), Jer 46:4 (polish the spears), Joel 3:10 (pruning hooks into spears), Ezek 39:9 (spears burned as fuel).
